name: Pomble · Gremlet #5
description:
A pot-bellied tanuki who keeps a leaf on its head for luck and drums its tummy when happy.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Pomble in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
